cohort: 637 singleton, nonanomalous pregnancies with an elevated 1-hour glucose screening test (GST) completed after 23 weeks of gestation
finding: Women with impaired glucose tolerance and ultrasound evidence of hyperglycemia (IGM-US) had higher rates of cesarean delivery and birth weight centile > 90th percentile compared to those with IGM alone.
mod_finding: Women with IGM-US had higher rates of cesarean delivery compared to those with IGM alone.
